scope: Read-only current-source privacy audit; no real credential supplied and no persistent-storage runtime claim

findings.finding: sourceInput initializes from localStorage and writes the full trimmed value on change for custom GPU model directory and WASM URLs; no credential-query filtering occurs here.
URL policy restricts scheme to HTTP/HTTPS but returns full href, preserving URL userinfo, query and fragment.
GPU resolution forces IndexedDB cache for ordinary and overridden records; no session-only authenticated-source path exists.

open_decision: Authenticated URL handling: session-only source with nonpersistent model cache, or explicit rejection. Do not strip query parameters and silently change resource identity.
acceptance_needed: Synthetic-credential URL must not appear in localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, OPFS, history or user-visible logs.
Chosen authenticated-source behavior must be verified through actual load and restart; ordinary public offline caches continue to work.
Do not claim complete privacy acceptance solely from source inspection.
